description: This PHP class 'ExtensionDiscovery' in Drupal core handles filesystem discovery of extensions such as modules, themes, and profiles. It includes methods for scanning directories, filtering by profiles, sorting extensions by origin, and processing discovered extensions.

classes.name: ExtensionDiscovery
classes.description: A class for discovering available extensions (modules, themes, profiles) in the Drupal filesystem, with methods for scanning directories, filtering, sorting, and processing extensions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ExtensionDiscovery object with root path, info parser usage, profile directories, and site path.

methods.name: scan
methods.description: Discovers extensions of a specified type across multiple directories, with optional inclusion of test modules.

methods.name: setProfileDirectoriesFromSettings
methods.description: Sets profile directories based on current site settings, handling special cases like no profile.

methods.name: getProfileDirectories
methods.description: Returns the list of profile directories to scan.

methods.name: setProfileDirectories
methods.description: Explicitly sets profile directories to scan.

methods.name: filterByProfileDirectories
methods.description: Filters extensions to include only those belonging to specified profile directories.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Sorts extensions based on origin and profile weights.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes sorted extensions, with later found extensions overriding earlier ones.

methods.name: scanDirectory
methods.description: Recursively scans a directory for extensions, filtering by extension type and test directories.
